claims.title: Caesar campaigns in the Low Countries
claims.summary: Julius Caesar's wars in Gaul bring Roman power to the peoples of the Rhine and Meuse delta, opening the region to Roman influence.

sources.label: The Netherlands in Roman Times
sources.publisher: Rijksmuseum van Oudheden (National Museum of Antiquities)

claims.title: The Batavian Revolt
claims.summary: Julius Civilis leads the Batavians and allied tribes in a revolt against Rome during the chaos after Nero's death; it is suppressed after roughly a year.

sources.label: The Netherlands in Roman Times
sources.publisher: Rijksmuseum van Oudheden (National Museum of Antiquities)

claims.title: Christianisation of the Frisians
claims.summary: Missionaries such as Willibrord begin converting the Frisians, tying the delta into the Christian, Frankish world of western Europe.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-690-christianisation-of-the-frisians, claim TL:NLD:event:690:christianisation-of-the-frisians, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: St. Lucia's flood
claims.summary: A catastrophic North Sea storm surge drowns tens of thousands and reshapes the coastline, helping form the Zuiderzee and underlining the delta's perpetual struggle with water.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1287-st-lucia-s-flood, claim TL:NLD:event:1287:st-lucia-s-flood, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: St. Elizabeth's flood
claims.summary: A storm surge breaks the dikes of the Grote Hollandse Waard, drowning villages and thousands of people and creating the Biesbosch wetlands.

sources.label: Rijksmuseum collection and the Dutch Golden Age

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1421-st-elizabeth-s-flood, claim TL:NLD:event:1421:st-elizabeth-s-flood, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Habsburg inheritance
claims.summary: Mary of Burgundy marries Maximilian of Habsburg, bringing the Low Countries under Habsburg rule after the death of Charles the Bold.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1477-habsburg-inheritance, claim TL:NLD:event:1477:habsburg-inheritance, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Seventeen Provinces united
claims.summary: Charles V's acquisition of Guelders completes the union of the Seventeen Provinces under a single Habsburg ruler.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1543-the-seventeen-provinces-united, claim TL:NLD:event:1543:the-seventeen-provinces-united, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Pragmatic Sanction
claims.summary: Charles V decrees that the Seventeen Provinces shall be inherited together as an indivisible whole, treating the Low Countries as a single political entity.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1549-pragmatic-sanction, claim TL:NLD:event:1549:pragmatic-sanction, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Abdication of Charles V
claims.summary: Charles V cedes the Low Countries to his son Philip II of Spain, whose centralising and anti-Protestant policies will ignite the Dutch Revolt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1555-abdication-of-charles-v, claim TL:NLD:event:1555:abdication-of-charles-v, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Beeldenstorm (Iconoclasm)
claims.summary: Calvinist crowds destroy religious images in churches across the Low Countries, provoking a harsh Spanish crackdown and pushing the provinces toward revolt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1566-the-beeldenstorm-iconoclasm, claim TL:NLD:event:1566:the-beeldenstorm-iconoclasm, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Eighty Years' War begins
claims.summary: Open revolt against Spanish rule breaks out under William of Orange, beginning a struggle for independence that will last eighty years.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1568-eighty-years-war-begins, claim TL:NLD:event:1568:eighty-years-war-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Union of Utrecht
claims.summary: The northern provinces sign a defensive alliance that becomes the constitutional foundation of the Dutch Republic.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1579-union-of-utrecht, claim TL:NLD:event:1579:union-of-utrecht, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Act of Abjuration
claims.summary: The States General formally renounce allegiance to Philip II of Spain, a de facto declaration of independence giving rise to the Republic of the Seven United Provinces.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1581-act-of-abjuration, claim TL:NLD:event:1581:act-of-abjuration, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Peace of Münster (Westphalia)
claims.summary: Spain formally recognises Dutch independence in the Peace of Münster, part of the Peace of Westphalia, ending the Eighty Years' War.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1648-peace-of-munster-westphalia, claim TL:NLD:event:1648:peace-of-munster-westphalia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of the VOC
claims.summary: The Dutch East India Company is chartered as the world's first publicly traded joint-stock company, with a monopoly on Dutch trade in Asia and powers to wage war and govern.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1602-founding-of-the-voc, claim TL:NLD:event:1602:founding-of-the-voc, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of the Dutch West India Company
claims.summary: The WIC is chartered for trade and conquest in the Americas and West Africa, becoming central to Dutch participation in the transatlantic slave trade.

sources.label: Slavery: the Rijksmuseum exhibition and Dutch colonial slavery

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1621-founding-of-the-dutch-west-india-company, claim TL:NLD:event:1621:founding-of-the-dutch-west-india-company, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Rembrandt paints The Night Watch
claims.summary: Rembrandt completes his monumental militia portrait, an emblem of the artistic achievement of the Dutch Golden Age, now in the Rijksmuseum.

sources.label: Rijksmuseum collection and the Dutch Golden Age

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1642-rembrandt-paints-the-night-watch, claim TL:NLD:event:1642:rembrandt-paints-the-night-watch, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Rampjaar (Disaster Year)
claims.summary: France, England and allied bishops invade the Republic; the Dutch open the dikes to flood the land and halt the advance, and William III rises to power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1672-the-rampjaar-disaster-year, claim TL:NLD:event:1672:the-rampjaar-disaster-year, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Batavian Republic
claims.summary: French Revolutionary forces and Dutch Patriots overthrow the stadtholderate and proclaim the Batavian Republic, ending the old Dutch Republic.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1795-the-batavian-republic, claim TL:NLD:event:1795:the-batavian-republic, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kingdom of the Netherlands founded
claims.summary: After Napoleon's defeat, the Congress of Vienna establishes the Kingdom of the Netherlands under William I, uniting the northern and southern Low Countries.

sources.label: History of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1815-kingdom-of-the-netherlands-founded, claim TL:NLD:event:1815:kingdom-of-the-netherlands-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belgian Revolution
claims.summary: The southern provinces rebel and declare independence as Belgium, dividing the United Kingdom of the Netherlands; separation is recognised in 1839.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1830-belgian-revolution, claim TL:NLD:event:1830:belgian-revolution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Liberal constitution of Thorbecke
claims.summary: A new constitution drafted by Johan Rudolf Thorbecke establishes ministerial responsibility and parliamentary government, founding modern Dutch democracy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1848-liberal-constitution-of-thorbecke, claim TL:NLD:event:1848:liberal-constitution-of-thorbecke, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Abolition of slavery
claims.summary: The Netherlands abolishes slavery in Suriname and the Caribbean, freeing enslaved people, though most are forced into ten more years of supervised plantation labour.

sources.label: Slavery: the Rijksmuseum exhibition and Dutch colonial slavery

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1863-abolition-of-slavery, claim TL:NLD:event:1863:abolition-of-slavery, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: German invasion and occupation
claims.summary: Nazi Germany invades the neutral Netherlands; after the bombing of Rotterdam the country surrenders, beginning five years of occupation.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1940-german-invasion-and-occupation, claim TL:NLD:event:1940:german-invasion-and-occupation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Holocaust in the Netherlands
claims.summary: From July 1942 the occupiers and Dutch collaborators deport some 107,000 Jews, mostly to Auschwitz and Sobibor; about 104,000 Dutch Jews are murdered, the highest proportion in Western Europe.

sources.label: The Netherlands: the greatest number of Jewish victims in Western Europe

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1942-the-holocaust-in-the-netherlands, claim TL:NLD:event:1942:the-holocaust-in-the-netherlands, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Indonesian independence
claims.summary: After a violent four-year war, the Netherlands transfers sovereignty over the Dutch East Indies to the Republic of Indonesia.

sources.label: Independence, Decolonization, Violence and War in Indonesia, 1945–1950
sources.publisher: NIOD Institute for War, Holocaust and Genocide Studies

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1949-indonesian-independence, claim TL:NLD:event:1949:indonesian-independence, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: North Sea flood and the Delta Works
claims.summary: A storm surge floods the southwest, killing more than 1,800 people in the Netherlands and prompting the construction of the Delta Works flood defences.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Netherlands: A nation reclaimed from the sea, born of revolt against an empire.", terralore.co/country/NLD/chronicle#ev-1953-north-sea-flood-and-the-delta-works, claim TL:NLD:event:1953:north-sea-flood-and-the-delta-works, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Suriname becomes independent
claims.summary: Suriname leaves the Kingdom of the Netherlands to become a sovereign state, while several Caribbean islands remain within the Kingdom. In 2022–2023 the Dutch government and King Willem-Alexander formally apologised for the Netherlands' role in slavery.

sources.label: Slavery: the Rijksmuseum exhibition and Dutch colonial slavery
